dispatched_brief.objective: Flag pharmacological interactions and tolerability concerns for candidate agents, in the context of a concurrent therapy with a labeled CYP1A2 interaction concern and of reported positional reduction in respiratory capacity, unintentional weight loss, an elevated muscle-enzyme value, liquid-associated swallowing or cough, and altered grip and pinch function. Swallowing impairment is only a retrieval hypothesis. Pair-specific exposure, interaction magnitude and route-specific tolerability are unknown.
